name: Storytelling (Domain)
body:
Storytelling is history and how knowledge is passed down. Passing of such knowledge is integral to existence, personal identity, and peoples forming communities.

Granted Powers
Esoteric Knowledge (Su)

You can draw upon your faith to recall information with more clarity. As swift action, you gain a bonus on your next Knowledge check equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum +1). You can use this ability a number times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Inspiring Stories (Su)

At 8th level, you gain inspire courage as a bard of your cleric level -4. For the purposes of this bardic performance you gain a number of rounds to use it equal to 1/2 your cleric level and the performance must be an auditory recitation of epic stories. If you have or later gain levels in classes that provide inspire courage, the levels stack for the strength of that ability and the number of total bardic performance rounds available.

Domain Spells: 1st–share language, 2nd–bestow insight, 3rd–good hope, 4th-grand destiny, 5th–legend lore, 6th-greater heroism, 7th–vision, 8th–discern location, 9th–heroic invocation
